name: Reverse Metamorphosis
source:
The story features an apathetic social recluse, shut inside his own room for most of the time, much to his own liking. ...Until the peaceful life inside his own mind is shattered by a strange encounter seemingly out of nowhere.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25906]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这个故事的主角是一个冷漠的社会隐士，大部分时间都关在自己的房间里，这很符合他自己的喜好。……直到他内心平静的生活被一场看似不知从何而来的奇怪遭遇打破。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25906]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
